infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: JARVIS AI uses the microphone only while you tap the mic button (or while foreground wake-word listening is switched on) to understand your voice commands.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Speech recognition converts what you say into text so the assistant can answer. You see the text before it is sent.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera is used to photograph crops or documents that you choose to send for AI analysis.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose existing photos of crops to analyse.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is used to fetch local weather. It is not stored.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Used to create calendar events you ask for.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Used to create calendar events you ask for.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Used to find a contact's phone number when you ask to call or message them.
